# Network Growth Assistant

> A personal planning and tracking tool for professional networking and job searching. An account is required to use it, and it never asks for a LinkedIn password.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): what it is, what it promises and how it works.
- [Guides](/guides): how to export your LinkedIn connections, build a networking plan and track job applications.
- [Sign in](/login): sign in or create an account with Google, email and password, or an email link.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): what is stored, why, and how to export or delete your data.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): the terms for using the app.
